coordinateSystem.x: +X along the boom, positive toward waterside (sea side)
coordinateSystem.z: along the rails (gantry travel). +Z is the right-hand side for a viewer standing landside and looking toward the water
coordinateSystem.origin: top of the waterside rail on the crane transverse centreline (landside rail at X = -30)
coordinateSystem.sideNames: Leg/corner suffix 'a' = +Z end, 'b' = -Z end. 'ws' = waterside (X = 0), 'ls' = landside (X = -30)

provenanceKinds.measured: dimension printed on the cited sheet, used as an exact input
provenanceKinds.drawing-derived: computed from printed dimensions (formula in the note)
provenanceKinds.estimated: visual estimate from a scaled reading of the cited view; provisional 5 % silhouette tolerance
provenanceKinds.approximate-location: placed inside a documented area; exact position/shape not established

revisionNote: U1 round 3 (2026-10-22): trolley rebuilt from J526A0200 / J526A2100 (4 wheels instead of 8, four sheave shafts with two sheaves each, open frame and centre body, trolley-rope equalizer sheaves, spreader cable reel, main hoist and trolley rope paths on the trolley); headblock re-read from J526A1200 and spreader remodelled (STS45 drawing still not supplied; ISO 1161 corner positions, DT1500F cradle spacing). Previous: U1 round 2 (2026-10-22): load cells at the trolley sheave shafts, girder-tail platforms and stairs, apex platform and boom-hoist sheave arrangement, floodlight fittings on the boom and girder, elevator position/car/landings and every location marker drawn as a simplified part (J526A0200, J526A2300, J526A5000, J526A5100). Previous: U1 repair (2026-10-21): back-reach area, CICT logo, stair tower orientation, cab remodel, reeving paths and machinery-house layout re-checked against J526A00, J526A1000, J526A3000, J526A3100, J526A5000, J526A7100. Draft v1 revised in place: no equipment binding is active.
